figure.purpose: Condensed headings, labels and figures; money values use tabular numerals.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The sale's single primary action, a full-width solid ink bar at the foot of its draft panel.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { width: 100%; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; background: #12212e; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #12212e; border-radius: 2px; padding: 12px 18px; font-family: 'Plex Condensed', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary-action:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #0a1622; } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b5f8a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-primary-action:disabled { background: #ffffff; color: #5f6f7d; border: 1px dashed #c3ccd6; cursor: default; } .ds-primary-action kbd { font-family: 'Plex Text', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 2px; padding: 1px 5px; opacity: 0.75; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A white field with a strong-rule outline and visible accent focus.
components.css: .ds-text-field { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #c3ccd6; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 2px; padding: 10px 11px; font-family: 'Plex Text', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #12212e; caret-color: #0b5f8a; } .ds-text-field::placeholder { color: #5f6f7d; } .ds-text-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b5f8a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-text-field:disabled { background: #fbfcfd; color: #5f6f7d; }

components.name: Work Panel
components.description: A closed white work area, separated from its neighbor by a 24px gap and its own rule.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e8ecf1; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; padding: 18px; min-width: 0; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: #12212e; font-family: 'Plex Condensed', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: #5f6f7d; font-family: 'Plex Text', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: A quiet 88px rail with the current destination marked by accent text and a left rule.
components.css: .ds-rail { width: 88px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: transparent; border-right: 1px solid #e8ecf1; color: #5f6f7d; } .ds-tab { display: block; padding: 12px 0; border-left: 3px solid transparent; color: #5f6f7d; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Plex Condensed', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #12212e; } .ds-tab.ds-active { border-left-color: #0b5f8a; color: #0b5f8a; }

components.name: Ledger Balance Row
components.description: A document row with its computed running balance in the left margin as one continuous column.
components.css: .ds-ledger { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; color: #12212e; font-family: 'Plex Text', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-ledger th { padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #c3ccd6; color: #5f6f7d; text-align: left; font-family: 'Plex Condensed', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-ledger td { padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e8ecf1; } .ds-ledger .ds-balance { padding-right: 16px; border-right: 1px solid #e8ecf1; color: #0b5f8a; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; font-family: 'Plex Condensed', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ledger .ds-total { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; font-family: 'Plex Condensed', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-state { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: #12212e; font-family: 'Plex Condensed', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-state i { width: 2px; height: 12px; background: currentColor; } .ds-state.ds-void { color: #a33227; } .ds-state.ds-pending { color: #8a6410; } .ds-ledger tr:hover td { background: #f2f6fa; } .ds-ledger tr:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b5f8a; outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview:
The printed account statement is the money document the shop already trusts. The day reads as one: every row is a computed figure and every balance is recomputed. This refuses the category default of a CRUD screen where state is a coloured pill nobody reads.

The signature is a running-balance column in the ledger's left margin, recomputed per row so it reads as one continuous number down the page. Work areas are contained in closed, bordered panels: their own edges establish separation, rather than whitespace alone. The sales surface and shell are documented here; `/products` and `/purchases` have not yet been redesigned and remain outside this system's implemented scope.
keyCharacteristics: A cold near-white ground, dark ink, quiet grey and a restrained blue accent.
Computed money figures, with a continuous running balance as the ledger's signature.
Closed, white work panels separated by their own border and a 24px gap.
State is readable text with a small colour tick, not a filled badge.

rules.name: The Balance Owns the Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep the blue accent for the running-balance column and active navigation. Focus and caret affordances also use the accent in the shared stylesheet; do not turn it into a general-purpose section colour or filled action colour.

rules.name: The State Is Readable Rule
rules.body: State is text plus a 2px tick. Confirmed stays in ink; annulled or refunded uses the void state colour; pending uses the pending state colour. Never encode a state only by colour.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Set money figures in Plex Condensed with tabular numerals; their aligned columns are part of how the statement is read.

dos: Do recompute and show a running balance beside each ledger row.
Do use the blue accent for the balance and active destination, and preserve its observed use for focus and caret affordances.
Do keep work areas closed by their own white surface, fine-rule border and 8px radius, with the observed 24px gap between sales panels.
Do render document state as legible text plus a 2px tick; keep confirmed state quiet in ink.
Do use the solid ink bar for the primary action.
Do strike through a cancelled or fully refunded row's amount and inherited balance.
donts: Don't use a filled state pill or a rotated rubber stamp.
Don't make the primary action a full-bleed accent band or an accent-filled button.
Don't replace the panel's separating border with whitespace alone.
Don't use a name from the transitional token alias block for a new component; those aliases are migration debt, not system tokens.
